    «{branch}».» / "A folder with files: the agents will work with them and commit to its current branch
    “{branch}”." (git `existing`), else `fo_new_files_plain` «Папка с файлами: агенты будут работать с ними.» / "A
    folder with files: the agents will work with them." followed by `fo_git_init` «В ней нет git-репозитория: он
    будет создан (git init и первый коммит ее файлов).» / "It has no git repository: one will be created (git init
    and a first commit of its files)." (`initialized`), `cd_git_disabled` (`disabled`) or `cd_git_none` (`none`).
    `use` "workspace" for a move, by the key `console.cd_preview` would give: `fo_unchanged` «Сессия уже работает
    в этой папке.» / "The session already works in this folder." (`unchanged`), else `cd_text_fresh` (`fresh`),
    `cd_text_lost` (`lost`), `cd_text_back` (`back`), `cd_text_missing` / `cd_text_empty` (`state`), `cd_text_files`
    (with files; then `fo_branch` «Текущая ветка: «{branch}».» / "Current branch: “{branch}”." when known), `{old}`
    the session's current folder; then the git line for `initialized` with files (`fo_git_init`), `disabled`,
    `none`; `fo_mcp` «Вместе с сессией переедут ее MCP-серверы: {names}.» / "The session's MCP servers move along:
    {names}." when `mcp` is not empty; `cd_text_running` when `running`; `cf_api` «Сессию создал клиент HTTP API, и
    она работает прямо в папке «{root}» из [api] folders: после смены папки это обычная ваша сессия, и проверки той
    папки к ней больше не относятся.» / "An HTTP API client created this session, and it works right in the folder
    “{root}” of [api] folders: after the change it is an ordinary session of yours, and that folder's checks no
    longer apply." when `api_folder`. The `cd_*` keys this picks are listed by name in `Folders.LINE_KEYS` (a
    `t("cd_" + key)` would escape the used-keys test).
  - **Folder browser** (`Folders.browse({use, session, start, onChoose, opener})`; `opener` the «Обзор…» button the
    focus goes back to), behind «Обзор…» / "Browse…" (`fo_browse`,
    a `button type="button"` after each path field, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`): a layer of its own above the page's
    modal (`#folder-picker` with its own backdrop, `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` its title
    `fp_title` «Папка на компьютере хаба» / "A folder on the hub's computer"), so the dialog under it keeps what was
    typed. Its requests are `POST /api/folders/list` `{path?, use, session?}`. It shows:
    - the places (`roots`) as a column of buttons (under 640 px a `select` above the list): `fp_root_home`
      «Домашняя папка» / "Home folder", `fp_root_drive` «Диск {name}» / "Drive {name}", `fp_root_system` «Корень
      (/)» / "Root (/)", the `recent` ones in a group of their own (`role="group"`; in the `select` an `optgroup`)
      under the heading `fp_recent` «Недавние папки» / "Recent folders"
      with the folder's last part as the label (the whole path as the tooltip), `fp_root_api` «Папка API: {name}» /
      "API folder: {name}" (the tooltip the path and `fp_root_api_hint` «из [api] folders в настройках» / "from [api]
      folders in the settings"), `fp_root_dreamteam` «Домашняя папка DreamTeam» / "DreamTeam home";
    - the path as a breadcrumb of buttons inside its root, after `fp_up` «Наверх» / "Up" (disabled at a root);
    - the subfolders (`ul role="listbox"` with `aria-label` the path, one `li role="option"` per entry), each with its
      name (`<bdi dir="ltr">`) and marks: `fp_repo` «git», `fp_empty` «пустая» / "empty" (`files` false),
      `fp_noaccess` «нет доступа» / "no access" (`noaccess`), `fp_link` «ссылка» / "link", `fp_busy` «занята
      сессией «{title}»» / "taken by session “{title}”" (`fp_creating` «создается сессия» / "a session is being
      created" for a `busy` without `sid`), `fp_current` «папка этой сессии» / "this session's folder"; a `refused`
      one muted with `fp_refused` «нельзя выбрать» / "cannot be chosen" and the reason as its tooltip and as a
      hidden text the entry points to with `aria-describedby`; a closed one (`open` false) `aria-disabled="true"`,
      still focusable (a screen reader hears why), never opened;
    - the status line (`role="status"`): `fp_loading` «Загрузка…» / "Loading…", `fp_none` «Здесь нет папок.» / "No
      folders here.", `fp_truncated` «Показаны {n} папок; остальные откройте, введя путь.» / "{n} folders are shown;
      open the others by typing the path.", `fp_partial` «Отметки есть не у всех папок: папка отвечает медленно.» /
      "Not every folder is marked: the folder answers slowly.", `fp_fallback` «Папки {path} нет: открыта ближайшая
      существующая.» / "{path} does not exist: the nearest existing folder is open.", or the answer's `error` or an
      error answer verbatim;
    - the foot: the shown folder's path, `fp_choose` «Выбрать эту папку» / "Choose this folder" (disabled when the
      answer's `selectable` is false, with `fp_cannot` «Эту папку выбрать нельзя: {why}» / "This folder cannot be
      chosen: {why}" under it, {why} the `refused` text, `fp_busy_why` «в ней работает сессия «{title}»» / "session
      “{title}” works in it", or `fp_nav_why` «это корень диска или файловой системы» / "it is a drive or file system
      root"), `fp_new` «Новая папка…» / "New folder…" (a name input with its own `fp_new_ok` «Выбрать» / "Choose":
      it fills the field with `path + sep + name` and closes; the folder is made by the create or the move, never by
      the browser, as `fp_new_hint` «Папка будет создана, когда сессия начнет в ней работать.» / "The folder is made
      when the session starts working in it." says; refused in the form: an empty name, `.` or `..`, a name with `/`,
      on a Windows hub (`sep` "\\") also with `\`, `:`, `*`, `?`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `|`, a control character, a
      trailing dot or space, or a device name (`CON`, `PRN`, `AUX`, `NUL`, `COM1`…`COM9`, `LPT1`…`LPT9`, with any
      extension, any case): `fp_new_bad` «Нужно только имя новой папки, а такое имя для папки на компьютере хаба не
      подходит.» / "Give just the new folder's name; this one cannot name a folder on the hub's computer."),
      `cancel`.
    It opens at the folder of its field when one is typed (`Folders.unquote` of the value; a missing one falls back
    to its nearest existing ancestor: `fallback`), else at the first root (the home on the host; the DreamTeam home,
    or the first api root, in a container); a 403 (outside the places, a network path) opens the first root with the
    error in the status line. One listing request at a time: a click while one runs supersedes it (`seq`, the stale
    answer dropped). «Выбрать эту папку», or a double click on an entry (the entry of its first click, which has
    started opening it: by the second click its subfolders may be under the pointer), puts the path into the field,
    closes the browser, gives the focus back to the field and checks it at once. The browser shows only the cheap
    marks; the full check runs on the chosen folder, in its field. The copy field's browser lists folders only: a
    .zip on the hub's computer is typed (its check says `fo_src_zip`).
    Keyboard, while the focus is in the list or the breadcrumb: ↑ / ↓ move between the entries, Home / End to the
    first / the last, Enter or Space opens the focused entry. Backspace or Alt+↑ goes up wherever the focus is in
    the browser outside the «Новая папка…» input (an empty folder puts the focus on «Выбрать эту папку», and the way
    up still works from there; the places select keeps its own keys). The list is one tab stop
    (a roving `tabindex`: the focused entry 0, the others -1). In the «Новая папка…» input those keys are the
    input's own, Enter is its «Выбрать», and the first Escape closes the input (the focus back on «Новая папка…»).
    Escape elsewhere closes the browser only and gives the focus back to «Обзор…»; Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside it
    (a focus trap); at open (and after each listing: on the folder it came up from, if listed) the focus is on the
    first entry, else on «Выбрать эту папку» (on `cancel` while that is disabled). A click on an entry opens it (a
    closed one only takes the focus); the narrow screen's `select` of places is named by the title
    (`aria-labelledby`), and a folder outside the places shows "—" there. A click on the browser's
    own backdrop closes the browser only. The dialog under it never sees these: a keydown listener on
    `#folder-picker` stops Escape there (`stopPropagation`; home.js's Escape handler and app.js's `onKeydown` are
    bubble-phase listeners on `document`), and while `Folders.isOpen()` both pages' backdrop handlers return at once
    and their Escape handlers close the browser alone (`Folders.closeBrowser`: an Escape while the focus has fallen
    out of the browser never discards the new-session dialog). `#folder-picker` takes the focus of a click on its
    text (`tabindex="-1"`), and the page's modal under it is `inert` while it is open. The page's `openModal` and
    `closeModal` close an open browser (it belongs to the dialog it was opened from).
  - **Change folder** (`Folders.changeDialog({sid, title, workspace, running, onDone})`): «Сменить папку…» / "Change
    folder…" (`cf_button`) opens the page's modal: the title `cf_title` «Папка сессии «{title}»» / "Folder of session
    “{title}”", `cf_now` «Сейчас: {path} ({kind})» / "Now: {path} ({kind})" ({kind} the card's badge text, «папки
    нет» for a missing one), the radios `cf_other` «Другая папка» / "Another folder" (checked at open: the path field
    `#cf-path` with «Обзор…», `use` "workspace" with `session`, and its check line) and `cf_default` «Вернуть в свою
    папку» / "Back to its own folder" (disabled while the session works in its own folder; chosen, it checks
    `{"default": true, "session"}` at once), the hint `cf_hint` «Пустая или новая папка: файлы сессии и история
    git переедут туда. Папка с файлами: агенты будут работать с ее файлами и коммитить в текущую ветку; прежняя
    папка останется как есть.» / "An empty or new folder: the session's files and git history move there. A folder
    with files: the agents work with its files and commit to its current branch; the previous folder stays as it
    is.", `cancel` and `cf_go` «Сменить папку» / "Change folder" (enabled by a `ready()` check without `error` and
    not "unchanged"). The click asks `confirm()` with the TUI's question, `cd_ask` or `cd_ask_default` ({title},
    {path} the check's `target`, {text} the check line's text, which holds `cd_text_running` for a running session:
    its agents stop for the move and go on afterwards); yes → `POST /api/sessions/{sid}/workspace` with `{"path":
    <the check's target>, "expect": <its expect>}` or `{"default": true, "expect": <its expect>}`. A check of a
    typed folder that could not run (`fo_check_failed`) blocks nothing, as for a create: the question's {path} is
    `Folders.unquote` of the field and the body `{"path": <it>}` without `expect` (the hub decides and says);
    «Вернуть в свою папку» needs an answer (its folder's path is the hub's). During the request the button, the ×
    and `cancel` are
    disabled, and `cf_moving` «Переношу…» / "Moving…" shown (no time limit of the page's own: a move across drives
    copies). While that request runs the dialog cannot close (`Folders.busy()`): Escape, its backdrop and `cancel`
    do nothing (`cancel` disabled), so its result or error is never lost and no second move starts. The answer's
    `result` is worded by `Folders.resultLines(result, title)`, the twin of `console.cd_result_lines` (keys
    `cd_unchanged`, `cd_moved`, `cd_now`, `cd_adopted`, `cd_created`, `cd_git_*`, `cd_mcp_moved`, `cd_old_kept`,
    `cd_old_mcp_committed`, `cd_old_mcp_uncommitted`, `cd_old_missing`, `cd_start_error`, listed by name), one toast
    per line (the `start_error` one an error toast); the modal closes; the sessions page reloads its list, the board
    waits for its socket (a running session restarts: its sockets close with 1012) and re-lists «Файлы»
    (`syncWorkspace`). An error (409: the folder changed since its check, a dirty repository, another session took
    it, a file in use, an unfinished earlier move; 500 with the undo's report) stays in the dialog (`#cf-error`), the
    dialog can close again, and the folder is checked again. Cancelling sends nothing; before the click Escape and a
    stray click close it like any modal of the page.
    Where: the card's folder line and its missing warning (sessions page), the head of «Файлы» (`#workspace-info`,
    after the path) and the missing-folder banner (`#workspace-banner`) on the board. Hidden for the legacy `main`
    (summary `legacy`; on the board the sid "main"), a session made by an earlier version (summary
    `earlier_version`; the board's `S.earlier`) and a standalone `dreamteam run` board (`sessionSid()` is "": no
    launcher). The board takes `title`, `workspace` and `running` from its snapshot (`swarm.session`,
    `swarm.workspace`).
  - **Texts shared with the terminal**: these keys of `console.CD_TEXTS` are copied under `cd_<key>`: `ask`,
    `ask_default`, `text_missing`, `text_empty`, `text_files`, `text_fresh`, `text_lost`, `text_back`,
    `text_running`, `unchanged`, `moved`, `now`, `adopted`, `created`, `git_moved`, `git_existing`,
    `git_initialized`, `git_disabled`, `git_none`, `mcp_moved`, `old_kept`, `old_mcp_committed`,
    `old_mcp_uncommitted`, `old_missing`, `start_error`; en as there, ru as there with е for ё, `ask` / `ask_default`
    without " [y/N] " (a `confirm()` has its own buttons). The terminal-only keys (`launcher_only`,
    `remote_relative`, `hint`, `missing`, `current`, `kind_*`, `file`, `text_unknown`, `continue`, `cancelled`) are
    not copied. A test compares the copied ones, so the web and the terminal word a move alike.
  - **Texts of the session folder** (both pages): `ws_moved_hint` «Сессия перенесена в эту папку («Сменить папку…»

    folder is back." (no `/cd`: it is refused for `main` and an earlier version's session, and a standalone `run`

- **home.html + home.js + home.css** (launcher page, `/`): header (DreamTeam, tabs «Сессии» / «Скиллы» /
  «Настройки», RU/EN, theme, connection state; the tab is kept in the URL hash, `#skills`); live updates from `/ws`
  plus a 5 s poll (a `sessions.changed` event with change "skills" or "skill-envs" reloads the skills); texts in ru
  and en.
  - Sessions tab: a big «Начать новую сессию» button, search and the filters all / running / stopped, and a
    card per session.
    - Card: title (link to the board), goal (or «ждёт запуска» for a pending goal), status badge (running /
      paused / stopped / goal done; a session paused for a member's question, summary `pause_reason` "question",
      stays in the paused state, its badge reads «Ждёт вашего ответа» / "Waiting for your answer" with the tooltip
      «{name} ждёт вашего ответа на вопрос #{id}» from the summary's `question`) and, for a running session in the
      user's wrap-up mode (summary `wrap_up`, read
      from the session database like `paused`), a warning badge «Завершается» / «Wrapping up», after the «Без
      интернета» badge (§7.2) a plain badge «API» for a session created through the HTTP API v1 (summary `via`
      "api", §21.4; `apiBadge`), its tooltip by summary `answers`: `api_hint_auto` (the hub itself answers the agents'
      questions and, on the task board, reviews) or `api_hint_manual` (the API client answers them, or the user on
      the board), both
      saying that `dreamteam -c` does not pick it, task progress bar (a thread session: the badge «Тред», the vote
      bar and «объявлений: N», §22.8), agents (working), spent/budget, model, last activity (the time of
      the session's last event, its tooltip «Активность: … · Создана: …»; without an event, the creation time and
      «Создана: …»),
      the session folder (summary `workspace`: the path, cut at the front when long and whole in the tooltip,
      and a badge «своя папка» (default) / «папка проекта» (adopted) / «перенесена» (moved), then the link button
      «Сменить папку…» / "Change folder…" (`data-cd="<sid>"`, "Folders on both pages" above; disabled while the
      card's start or stop request runs); a folder outside the session that does not exist gets the badge «папки
      нет» and the warning `ws_missing` with that button inside it instead), right after it for a session made with
      a copy (summary `copied_from`, `copiedLine`) the line «Копия:» / "Copy of:" with the source (cut at the front
      when long, whole in the tooltip with «Файлы скопированы при создании сессии (when), файлов: N, size.
      Оригиналы не менялись.»; nothing for a missing or malformed value), the error of a damaged session. The search
      also matches the path and the
      copy's source. A session made by an earlier version (summary `earlier_version`, §17.2) gets the badge
      «Прежняя версия» / "Earlier version" in place of its status and the message of §17.2 in its twin (ru / en);
      its title is no link, its goal has no «ждёт запуска» (it never starts here), and it has no «Открыть» or
      «Запустить», only delete (none for the legacy `main`: its
      message names the file to remove). Such a card has the state `earlier` (`sessionState`): the top stripe and the
      dot of a stopped one, the badge in the warning colour, the message as a warning line under the error line; the
      folder line keeps its path and «папки нет» badge but not the warning that the session cannot start nor
      «Сменить папку…» (its move is refused, 409), and there is no proposals button (its dialog's request would be
      refused; the delete dialog still names the proposals).
      The filters list it under «Остановлены», never «Работают». The message's `{version}` is the hub's
      (`GET /api/hub`, asked once and only when a listed session is such a one; «?» until it answers or when it
      fails), and the `{home}` of `main` is its summary's `dir` (the home), else the hub's `home`.
    - Card buttons: «Открыть», «Запустить» / «Остановить» (disabled while the request runs), delete (not for
      the legacy `main`) with a confirmation dialog naming the session; for a folder outside the session the
      dialog says the folder stays, and the toast names it (`workspace_kept` of the DELETE answer). The folder
      changes with «Сменить папку…» on the card's folder line ("Folders on both pages" above), as with `/cd`, MCP
      `session_cd` or REST; the legacy `main` has no such button (`LEGACY_WORKSPACE_TEXT`). When members' skill
      proposals wait for the user (summary `skills_pending`, or a 409 with `pending_skills` for one proposed since),
      the dialog names them and offers «Сохранить в библиотеку и удалить» (`?skills=save`; a library clash
      refuses, shown in the dialog) and «Удалить вместе с ними» (`?skills=discard`) instead of a plain «Удалить».
    - Skills on the card: «скиллов: N» (summary `skills`) and, while proposals wait, a warning button «Скиллы ждут
      вашего решения: N» that opens a dialog with one row per proposal (owner, description, files): «Сохранить в
      библиотеку» / «Не сохранять» with an optional reason (`POST /api/sessions/{sid}/skills/{name}/decide`, also on
      a stopped session; a library clash, 409 `exists`, asks «В библиотеке уже есть другой скилл «x». Заменить его?»
      and decides again with `replace`).
  - New-session modal: title (default: the goal's first line, derived by the server); goal (required,
    multi-line: the first line is the title, the other lines its description, explained by a hint);
    description; the checkbox «Сначала уточнить цель» / "Clarify the goal first" (`#ns-clarify`, in the main grid
    right after «Режим работы» and «Решение о цели» (`#ns-mode`, `#ns-rule`, which follow the description, §22.8),
    with the hint «планировщик сначала задаст вам вопросы по неясным местам цели,
    остальные агенты подождут план и не потратят токены; важный вопрос агента поставит весь рой на паузу до вашего
    ответа» (while «Тред» is chosen, the hint is `f_clarify_thread_hint` instead, §22.8); ticked from the saved
    `swarm.clarify`, sent as `swarm.clarify` only when it differs, §3.1); model
    profile (from the saved settings; a role with its own profile keeps it); language, max agents, budget; the
    starting team composer (below; from the saved catalog); «Скиллы»: a checkbox per skill of the library and of
    Claude Code (a library skill is sent as its name, Claude Code's as `claude-user:x`;
    one changed outside DreamTeam carries the warn badge «изменён вне DreamTeam» and ticking it asks «подключить всё
    равно?», as the board's attach dialog does), the skills the chosen team's roles bring (from the catalog's
    `skills`; one not in the library or ~/.claude/skills gets a warning chip «нет в библиотеке») and «Добавить новый:
    папка, zip или Git» (the shared form; what it imports is ticked); the ticked ones go as `skills`, with «Прямо в
    папке проекта» chosen also the rows of that folder's `.claude/skills` ("Working folder" below); under
    «Дополнительно» steps per wake-up, MCP
    approval and «Без интернета для агентов» (`swarm.network = "off"`, §7.2; sent only when it differs from the saved
    default; its hint is `networkHint(network_isolation of GET /api/settings)`: strict only for "docker" / "netns",
    the "env" and "container" texts say plainly that it is not isolation, "container" that a restart of the sandbox
    adds the firewall); «Запустить сразу» with «Создать и открыть» (or «Создать»). The block «Рабочая папка» /
    "Working folder" sits in the main grid (not under «Дополнительно»), right after «Сначала уточнить цель» (below:
    the folder decides what the team works on, so it is seen before the team is chosen). Only values that differ
    from the saved defaults are sent as overrides (the team as `swarm.starting_roles` / `start_agents`). With teams
    saved, the select `#ns-team` («Команда», first option «Роли ниже», right before the composer) fills the composer's
    rows with a chosen team and sets the max to the larger of the typed value (else the saved `max_agents`) and the
    team's size; a team with a role the catalog lacks is disabled, naming the first such role; a pick the settings no
    longer support (another client saved while the dialog was open) changes nothing, puts the select back and says so;
    the first option undoes a pick, bringing back the rows from before it and their max (a max typed since stays); any
    edit of the rows resets the select and keeps those rows; the rows are what the session is created from, so no team
    name is sent. A stray
    click or Escape asks before discarding a typed goal. Independent review and the check of a crew task as a
    whole are not fields of the modal (the settings page has them; sessions can still override them through the
    API).
  - Working folder (new-session modal, `#ns-ws`: a `fieldset` with the legend «Рабочая папка» / "Working folder",
    `f_ws`; one choice of three, radios `name="ns-ws"`; the folder is kept apart from the copy because the two answer
    different questions: where the agents work, and what they start with):
    - `own` «Новая папка сессии» / "New session folder" (`f_ws_own`; checked at open, the behaviour of a dialog
      without the block), its hint `f_ws_own_hint` «Сессия начнет с пустой папки внутри домашней папки DreamTeam;
      эта папка удаляется вместе с сессией.» / "The session starts with an empty folder of its own inside the
      DreamTeam home; that folder is deleted with the session.";
    - `copy` «Копия папки или zip» / "Copy of a folder or a zip" (`f_ws_copy`; §17.2 "Copying files into a new
      session"; the former «Дополнительно» → «Файлы для работы» block, moved here, its heading key `f_files` gone):
      «Скопировать из папки» (`#ns-copy-from`, `f_copy_from`, the placeholder `f_copy_from_ph`) with «Обзор…» (`use`
      "source") and its check line `#ns-copy-check` (`use` "source"), «или загрузить .zip» (`#ns-copy-zip`, a file
      input, `accept=".zip,application/zip"`), the hint `f_copy_hint` (the files are copied before the first start,
      the originals are never changed, `.git`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `venv`, `__pycache__` and links are left out,
      the limit `copyMaxMb()`: the saved `workspace.copy_max_mb`, 1024 when missing) and the hint `#ns-copy-sandbox`
      (`f_copy_sandbox`, shown only when `GET /api/skills` reports `container` (or `sandbox`): `nsCopySandbox()`, at
      the dialog's start and again in `loadSkills()` while it is open) that the hub in a Docker container sees only
      its home, so a folder from the user's computer goes as a .zip;
    - `project` «Прямо в папке проекта» / "Directly in a project folder" (`f_ws_project`): «Папка» / "Folder"
      (`#ns-ws-path`, `f_ws_folder`, the placeholder `f_copy_from_ph`) with «Обзор…» (`use` "workspace") and its check
      line `#ns-ws-check` (`use` "workspace", no session), the hint `f_ws_project_hint` «Агенты меняют, создают и
      удаляют файлы этой папки и коммитят в текущую ветку ее репозитория (папку без git DreamTeam сделает
      репозиторием). Пока сессия работает, не правьте эти файлы сами. При удалении сессии папка остается.» / "The
      agents change, create and delete files in this folder and commit to the current branch of its repository
      (DreamTeam makes a folder without git a repository). Don't edit these files yourself while the session runs.
      Deleting the session keeps the folder.", and in a container (as `#ns-copy-sandbox` decides) `#ns-ws-sandbox`,
      `f_ws_sandbox` «Хаб работает в песочнице Docker: здесь доступны только папки внутри его домашней папки и папки
      [api] folders с in_place.» / "The hub runs in the Docker sandbox: only the folders inside its home and the [api]
      folders with in_place are available here.".
    Only the chosen choice's fields show (the others `hidden`; their values stay while the dialog is open, so going
    back loses nothing); a stray click or Escape asks before discarding a typed path of either or a chosen zip
    (`closeModal` reads `#ns-copy-from`, `#ns-ws-path`, `#ns-copy-zip`).
    - **Never both**: the dialog sends `workspace` (with `expect`) for `project` and `copy_from` / `copy_from_upload`
      for `copy`, never the two together; a copy into a folder of the user's stays with the CLI, the MCP and REST
      (target empty or missing, §17.2). So the 409 "already has files ...: a copy goes into a new or empty folder"
      never comes from this dialog, and neither choice has to be checked against the other.
    - **Submit** (`submitNewSession`): `own` sends neither. `copy` as the former block: nothing given is refused
      (`f_copy_none` «Укажите папку или выберите .zip.» / "Give a folder or choose a .zip."), a path together with a
      zip (`f_copy_both`), a file that is not `.zip` (`f_copy_zip_only`) and a zip over the limit (`f_copy_zip_big`)
      before any request (the message in `#ns-error`); a path whose current check has an `error` is refused with
      that text; then the button and the fields of the block are disabled and «Загрузка архива (N МБ)…» or
      «Копирование файлов…» shown. With a zip it first calls `uploadZip(file)`: `POST
      /api/uploads?filename=<encodeURIComponent(name)>` with `Content-Type: application/zip` and the File itself as
      the body (a raw-body upload, unlike the skills form's base64 JSON; same-origin `fetch` sends the hub cookie),
      which throws with the hub's `error`, `<status> <statusText>` for the guard's plain-text answers, `conn_lost`,
      or when a 2xx answer has no `upload` token; the create then carries only `copy_from_upload`. A path goes as
      `copy_from`, the value the check sent (`Folders.unquote`). Every submit uploads again (the create may have
      claimed the token). `project`: no path is `f_ws_none` «Укажите папку проекта.» / "Give the project folder.";
      the create needs a check of exactly the field's value that the user has seen (`checker.ready()`, "Folders on
      both pages" above): when there is none yet (the 400 ms not over, or the answer not in), the submit runs the
      check at once, shows its line and creates nothing, with `f_ws_checked` «Папка проверена: прочитайте под ней,
      что произойдет, и нажмите кнопку еще раз.» / "The folder was checked: read below it what will happen, and
      click the button again." in `#ns-error` once its answer is in (an answer with an `error` puts that text
      there instead; a check that could not run, only its line); a check with an `error` refuses with that text; a
      check whose mode is
      "adopted" asks `confirm()` first, `f_ws_confirm` «Сессия будет работать прямо в папке {path} с ее файлами:
      {text} Продолжить?» / "The session will work right in the folder {path}, with its files: {text} Go on?"
      ({path} the check's `target`, {text} the check line's text; as every move of the change dialog asks, so does a
      create that hands the user's files to the agents; "no" creates nothing); else the body gets `workspace` = the
      check's `target` and `expect` = its `expect` (`created` or `adopted`). A check that could not run
      (`fo_check_failed`: no connection, 429, 5xx) does not block: the create is sent with `workspace` =
      `Folders.unquote` of the field and without `expect`, and the hub decides and says. A 409 of the create (the
      folder changed since its check) shows its text and checks the folder again.
    - **After the create**: without «Запустить сразу» a success shows the toasts of `copyToasts(copy)` from the
      answer's `copy`: «Скопировано файлов: N (size)» (`sizeText`: KB, MB) and, when something was left out, «Не
      скопированы: ссылки (N: a, b, c, …); папки по имени (N: …); особые файлы (N)»; for `project` the lines of
      `Folders.resultLines(result, title)` (`cd_created` / `cd_adopted`, then the git line). With «Запустить сразу»
      the browser goes to the board, unless `links_count` or `special_count` is above 0 (folders left out by name are
      expected): then the dialog closes on the sessions page with the same toasts, the last one clickable («Сессия
      запущена. Нажмите, чтобы открыть её доску.», 9 s) and a click opens the board. An error re-enables the fields.
    - **Skills of the folder**: with `project`, a check without `error` whose `state` is "files" makes the modal ask
      `GET /api/skills?workspace=<encodeURIComponent(target)>` itself (`H.nsProject = {path, items}`; `H.skills` and
      the Skills tab stay as they are) and list the `claude` items of origin `claude-project` after the other rows,
      sent as `claude-project:<name>`, with the badge `claude-project` and the hint `f_skills_project` «из
      .claude/skills этой папки: агенты могут менять эти файлы» / "from this folder's .claude/skills: agents can
      change these files"; another folder, another choice or a check with an error drops those rows and their
      ticks; an answer for a folder that is no longer the checked one is dropped; a 400 for a network path (§17.2)
      just offers no rows. (This ends the earlier deviation from §7.4: the dialog had no folder, so it offered no
      `claude-project:x` rows.)
    - **In the Docker sandbox**: `own` and the zip work as on the host. `project`'s browser lists only the mounted
      folders and the check refuses any other with `_container_refusal`'s text (§17.2). `copy`'s browser lists only
      the mounted roots of `[api] folders` (the home is never a copy source): when `nsCopySandbox()` first finds the
      hub in a container, the dialog asks `POST /api/folders/list` `{"use": "source"}` (no path: the roots alone)
      once, and without any root «Обзор…» is disabled with `f_copy_sandbox` as its tooltip (a request that failed
      leaves the button as it is and is asked again; an answer for a closed dialog is dropped); a typed path of the
      user's computer gets the sandbox text of `resolve_source` in the check line ("... Upload the folder as a .zip in
      the New session dialog ..."), which the zip field next to it answers.
  - Team composer (new-session modal, settings' defaults, saved teams): one row per group of the starting team (§17.3
    `team_rows`; JS twins `teamRows` / `teamValue`): a role select over the visible catalog plus «Своя роль…» (a
    name not in the catalog), −/+ count (1..50; a row a saved team already holds above 50 keeps that count as its limit,
    and a typed count above the limit shows as the limit), the role's first sentence (full description as tooltip) and
    its model profile (for a role without one, muted, «модель: как у сессии»; none on a «Своя роль…» row, whose typed name may be a role with a profile), ✕; «Добавить роль»; the total. A re-render gives the focus back to the same control (keyboard
    users). An empty team, an own role name with `,` or `*` (they separate
    team items) or more agents than the max is refused in the form; an untouched default is never written back.
    The new-session modal sends `starting_roles` when a saved team is picked in `#ns-team`, and otherwise only when the
    saved list, at the new size, would give another
    team (the saved list may hold more roles than its `start_agents`: they would fill a larger team). A saved team's
    composer (Settings → «Команда») is headed «Состав», without the hint, «Своя роль…» or its input: a team holds
    catalog roles only. Its add button reads «Добавить строку», and ↑/↓ move a row, since the order is who is woken
    first and who plans; the focus follows the row. A role the catalog lacks shows as a selected, disabled option in a
    row marked in the error colour (`.team-gone`), with the hint «Этой роли больше нет в каталоге: выберите другую или
    уберите строку.»; a hidden role shows as elsewhere: selected, marked «(скрыта)», and not offered to other rows.
  - Settings tab: sections «Модели и эндпоинты», «Роли», «Команда», «Новые сессии по умолчанию» (with the team
    composer, the budget «Бюджет сессии, $», `swarm.max_cost_usd`, followed by «Предупредить о бюджете при доле»
    (en "Budget warning at share"), `swarm.budget_notice_at`, a number field (min 0, max 1, step 0.05) whose hint
    reads «При этой доле потраченного бюджета агенты и вы получаете одно предупреждение (0.8 — 80 %); 0 или 1 — без
    него.» (en "At this share of the budget spent, the agents and you get one notice (0.8 = 80 %); 0 or 1: none.";
    only here, §17.1; the server refuses a value out of range), and
    the switches «Независимое ревью задач», `swarm.independent_review`, «Проверять групповую задачу целиком» (en
    "Check a crew task as a whole"), `swarm.crew_review`, whose hint reads «Завершённую владельцем групповую задачу
    проверяет, по возможности, агент вне её направлений: сочетаются ли они; будет ли ревью вообще, решает
    независимое ревью. Выключено — без второго ревью, ведь каждое направление уже проверено: задача готова, как только
    владелец её завершит, даже с назначенным ревьюером.» (en "A crew task its owner completed is checked, preferably
    by a member outside its directions, for how they fit together; whether there is a review at all follows
    independent review. Off: no second review, since each direction was reviewed already: the task is done once its
    owner completes it, even with a reviewer named."; only here: neither the new-session modal nor the board's ⚙
    dialog has it), and «Сначала уточнять
    цель»,
    `swarm.clarify`, whose hint says it does not apply to `dreamteam -p` with automatic replies, then «Режим работы»
    and «Решение о цели» (`swarm.mode`, `swarm.goal_rule`, §22.8), and «Интернет для
    команд агентов», `swarm.network`, a select with the same honest hint), «Агенты» (with the planning hint's

    `file_max_wait_seconds`, `trigger_wake_seconds` with theirs, §8, then «Сводка подписок, с»,
    `agents.digest_seconds`, §22.8), «Консоль», «Workspace» (`workspace.git`,
    `lock_ttl_minutes` ≥ 1 and `lock_wanted_minutes` ≥ 0 with its hint, §7 "Lock waiters"; then «Копия в новую сессию,

    zip”: the largest copy and uploaded .zip"), and «Файлов в такой копии»,
    `workspace.copy_max_files`, both at least 1), «MCP»,
    «Скиллы», «Трейсы», «Сервер», with a section navigation.
    - Roles: a card per catalog role (from `role_presets` and `settings.roles`). A built-in role: its name in
      both languages (read-only), «встроенная» / «изменена» marks, «Сбросить» and «Скрыть» / «Показать»;
      description (a changed one applies to agents of both languages), model profile, extra instructions. An own
      role: an editable name, the same fields, delete. Both have «Скиллы»: chips of the role's skills (✕ removes one,
      a warning one is not in the library or ~/.claude/skills) and an input with the known names as suggestions
      plus «Добавить» (Enter too; a name must be a skill name: lowercase letters, digits and `-`). Saved as
      `settings.roles` (only what differs from the built-in texts; `skills` when not empty); client checks (names,
      duplicates, a description for an own role, a known profile, skill names) are shown in the save bar.
    - Teams («Команда», English "Teams"): a card per saved team (`settings.teams`), with an editable name, delete and
      the saved team's composer; «Добавить команду». A card's composer id is generated (`tm<n>`), never the team's
      name. Saved as `settings.teams` by `teamEntries`: `{name, roles}`, the rows expanded, trailing generalists kept.
      Client checks, the first one found shown in the save bar: no name; a name over 60 characters (code points, as the
      server; the name inputs of team and role cards have no `maxlength`, which counts UTF-16 units and cuts with no
      message), with `,` or `*`, or starting with `-`; a name with a control or invisible character other than the
      joiners of §17.3 (`TEAM_NAME_JOINERS`), or of those alone; a reserved name
      (`TEAM_RESET_WORDS`, the twin of `roles.TEAM_RESET`); two teams of one
      name; a team with no rows; a row whose role is missing from the edited catalog, unless it was already missing
      from the saved settings, so a team broken by a hand edit blocks no other save. More than 200 agents is refused
      by the server only. Rows are never changed automatically: a role renamed or deleted in the form leaves its rows
      on the old name, shown as gone, and Save refuses, naming the team and the role and going to that row, until it
      picks another role (the new name in the same save passes) or goes. Deleting a card leaves the focus on the delete
      button of the card now in its place, else of the last card, else on «Добавить команду».
    - Model profiles: one card per profile. Fields: name, provider, base_url, key (mode «Переменная
      окружения» with its state on the server, or «Ключ»: a password input that is never filled from the
      server, «сохранён …abcd», a button to remove it), model (input + datalist filled by «Загрузить список»),
      max_tokens, context window, the max_tokens ceiling (after a cut-off reply, §6.2), effort, thinking (Anthropic) or the max-tokens parameter (OpenAI), and under
      «Дополнительно» thinking display, prefix-mismatch handling and fallbacks (Anthropic), prices and extra
      request parameters (JSON). Buttons «Проверить» (models list) and «Тестовый запрос» (live); key-like text
      in the results is masked; the live result says how its cost was obtained (`cost_source`: «сообщил
      провайдер», «по ценам профиля», «по встроенным ценам», «бесплатно», «неизвестна…» / «неполная…»). Default
      profile (★, cannot be deleted), add from a preset, delete. Filling a card from a preset sets its four prices
      to the preset's (empty when it has none), so the previous preset's prices never stay on the card.
    - Prices (the hint: empty = the built-in prices of known Claude models, otherwise those tokens count as $0
      unless the provider reports the cost; 0 = free): a profile whose `price_source` is `none` or `partial` (and
      whose provider is not `scripted`) shows a warning outside «Дополнительно» (`.price-warn`): «Нет цен: вызовы этой
      модели считаются по $0, и бюджет сессии их не видит, если только провайдер не сообщает стоимость сам
      (проверьте «Тестовым запросом»).» or «Нет цены выхода: эти токены считаются по $0.», with «Указать цены»
      (opens «Дополнительно», the cursor in the first missing price) and «Бесплатная модель (0 / 0)» (both prices
      0). The server computes `price_source` for the saved model: while the card's model is the saved one, typing
      the missing prices hides the warning at once (`missingPrices`); another model typed in shows none until the
      settings are saved.
    - The external MCP servers are a JSON field; their `env` values come masked (`••••…abcd`) and are kept
      when sent back unchanged.
    - «Консоль» (`[shell]`, §17.1): the shell; the default wait for a command (`timeout`); «Наибольший тайм-аут
      команды» (`max_timeout`, with a hint: a command that went to the background at its timeout lives this long
      from its start, and an AI agent's wait itself is capped by the next field, 600 s over MCP); «ИИ-агент ждёт
      команду не дольше» (`foreground_max`); the switch «Долгие команды — в фон» (`background_on_timeout`);
      background jobs per member and per session (`max_jobs_per_member`, `max_jobs`); their time limit in minutes
      (`job_max_minutes`, 0 = none); their output in MB (`job_log_mb`); compute threads per command (`cpu_threads`:
      empty or "auto" in any case saves "auto", digits save the number, anything else is sent as typed for the
      server to refuse); the environment variables passed to the console (`pass_env`).
    - «Скиллы» (`[skills]`, §19): the library folder, Claude Code's skills on or off, the limits (MB and files per
      skill, an archive or Git copy in MB, skills per session, members' proposals per session, 0 = none), package
      installation (on, also for proposals, npm scripts), the environments' folder and Python, the time limit of one
      install, removing unused environments after N days (0 = never) and the installers' environment variables (a
      list); a note says changes apply from the next attach or session start.
    - A save bar with «Сохранить» (PUT) and «Отменить изменения»; client-side checks (profile names,
      duplicates, a model is required, JSON fields) and server errors are shown there. Leaving the tab or the
      page with unsaved edits asks first.
    - Models and limits apply to running sessions at once; server settings after a restart of `dreamteam serve`.
  - Skills tab (`GET /api/skills`): «Библиотека» (the folder named; a card per skill: name, description, files and
    size, «добавил(а): … · через …», warning badges «изменён вне DreamTeam» (with what it means) and «только по
    запросу» for a manual one, an error for a damaged entry; «Показать» opens its files, the packages preview and its
    SKILL.md, `?from=library`; «Удалить из библиотеки» asks first, `DELETE /api/skills/{name}?confirm=name`, sessions
    keep their copy), «Добавить в библиотеку» (the shared form), «Claude Code» (~/.claude/skills and the project's,
    read only: «Показать» and «В библиотеку», `POST /api/skills {claude, origin}`, with «в библиотеке» / «в
    библиотеке другой» badges by digest) and, inside the Docker sandbox, «Библиотека хоста» (read only; «В
    библиотеку», `{host}`). The hero has «Удалить неиспользуемые окружения» (`POST /api/skill-envs/cleanup`; the toast
    says how many were removed and kept).
- **index.html + app.js + traces.js** (session board, `/s/{sid}/`):
  - A thread session (§22) has the tab «Тред» in place of «Доска», «События» for «Лента», «+ Объявление», post and
    comment links in `md()`, `#goal-btn` opening #1 and the snapshot fields of §22.8 "Board page of a thread
    session"; the rest of this bullet is the board session's page.
  - All API/WS/MCP URLs are relative to the session base `/s/{sid}` (`BASE`, the same id pattern as the
    server), with `""` when the page is served at `/` (`dreamteam run`).
  - Texts written by agents, external members or the user are shown as Markdown (`markdown.js`, loaded before
    app.js; app.js `md()`): chat messages, the agent's reply, thinking and compaction summary in its activity (tool
    calls and results stay raw), task description (formatted, «Изменить» opens its textarea) and result, discussion
    posts (review comments included), the goal's description and summary, trigger notes, role and MCP
    descriptions, the reply and thinking of an LLM span in «Трейсы», and `.md` / `.markdown` files in «Файлы»
    (formatted by default, a button switches to the source). A safe subset: everything is escaped, raw HTML is shown
    as text, links only to http(s) and mailto (opened in a new tab, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`), images become
    links, no math (`$..$`, `$$..$$`, `\(..\)`, `\[..\]` are shown as written, no emphasis or escapes inside); a
    single newline is a line break, and a text without Markdown looks as written (lines keep their indentation,
    extra blank lines stay); task links `#12` and @mentions work in the plain text (not in code, math or links). Toasts, the feed, one-line previews and tooltips stay plain. Rendered HTML is cached by text.
  - Topbar: «← Все сессии» link to `/` and the session title; a stopped banner with «Запустить сессию»
    (POST `/api/sessions/{sid}/start`, then reload). Actions on a stopped session show the stopped message.
    A board page left open on a session made by an earlier version (§17.2; an import replaced it, a cached page)
    meets the answers of §18.1: an action's 409 with `earlier_version` shows its own text, not the stopped message
    (`actError`); that 409 of a refresh, or the close 1011 with the reason `made by an earlier version`, puts the
    launcher's message (English, like the hub's errors; the close starts a refresh whose 409 brings it) in the
    connection banner, where it stays, and the board stops reconnecting and polling (`showEarlier`). The socket is
    accepted before that close, so the refresh's 409 may come before the close or after it; either order ends the
    same. Any other close reconnects as before.
    A folder outside the session that does not exist (snapshot `swarm.workspace`) adds a banner naming the
    path and the fix (`ws_missing` with the «Сменить папку…» button, "Folders on both pages"; `ws_missing_back`,
    bring the folder back, where the button is hidden).
  - Wrap-up (§3): a toggle button «Завершать» / «Wrap up» (`ic-check`, label hidden on phones) right after «Пауза»
    calls `swarm_control` {wrap_up: !snapshot swarm.wrap_up} (`toggleWrapUp`); while the mode is on the button is
    pressed (class `on`, `aria-pressed`, the warning colour, tooltip: click to switch it off) and a banner under the
    header says what it means (`#wrapup-banner`). The feed shows `swarm.wrap_up` («… включил(а) режим завершения:
    агенты завершают задачи с тем, что есть» / «… выключил(а) режим завершения»).
  - Pause and questions (§3.1): «Пауза» / «Продолжить» calls `swarm_control`; a pause goes through `act(tool, args,
    quiet)` with quiet set, so its English result is not toasted: the banner says it, and with jobs running the
    `u_paused_jobs` notice comes as a toast like every user notice (a refusal is still toasted; a resume toasts its
    result as before). The user's own pause reads «Рой на паузе: по вашему решению» in the banner (`"reason_paused
    by the user"`, en "paused by you"; the TUI's `reason_user` alike, «Рой на паузе (по вашему решению)»; a job's
    «остановлен вами» is another key and stays). The banner `#paused-banner` names the
    reason. A question pause (snapshot `swarm.question`) reads «Рой на паузе: {name} ждёт вашего ответа на вопрос #{id}
    — ответ получат все участники. Нажмите, чтобы ответить; «Продолжить» снимает паузу без ответа» (class `question`,
    `data-asker`; a click, or Enter / Space on the focused banner (`role="button"`, `tabindex` 0), opens the chat with
    the asker: `onDocumentClick`, `onKeydown`). The banner says what Resume does before the click at every width (a
    touch screen shows no tooltip, a phone hides the button's label); the resume button keeps its short label
    «Продолжить» (a longer one would overflow the top bar), and its tooltip is «Продолжить без ответа: агент выберет
    вариант сам». The chat with
    the asker, and the «Все сообщения» chat (a message to all answers too), shows above its composer (`#chat-hint`,
    added at init) «Ваше следующее сообщение — ответ на вопрос #{id}: его получат все участники, и рой продолжит
    работу.»; a message sent meanwhile to someone else (not the asker, not all) gets the toast «Рой всё ещё ждёт
    вашего ответа агенту {name} (вопрос #{id})», and a click on it opens the asker's chat. The `u_question`
    notification shows no toast (the banner says it). While not paused, `swarm.clarify_wait` {name, task_id} (the
    server's `asks_user`, not the card's status) shows a quiet banner (class `quiet`) «{name} ждёт ваших ответов на
    вопросы по цели — ответьте в чате», and a click opens that chat too; it hides when the field is null. The feed
    shows `swarm.paused` for a question («{asker} задаёт вам вопрос #N — рой на паузе до вашего ответа») and
    `swarm.resumed` with `question`: «ваш ответ на вопрос #N получили все участники, рой продолжил работу» (answered),
    «рой продолжил работу без ответа на вопрос #N» (dropped), with «уточнение цели выключено: …» (why `clarify_off`)
    and «{asker} покинул(а) рой: …» (why `left`); the feed's `swarm.*` lines are escaped, not linkified, so `#N` (a
    message id) is no task link. The feed also shows a run's start and end (FEED_TYPES `session.*`, §9): «сессия
    запущена», «сессия остановлена: бюджет исчерпан», «сессия не запустилась: <error>»…, escaped like `swarm.*`.
    In a thread session the tab is «События» and `FEED_TYPES` adds `post.created` (§22.8).
  - Reviews (§4.1): a card waiting for the user's review has the badge «ждёт вашего ревью», another one in review
    names its reviewer; the task card's «Принять» / «Вернуть» (a return needs a comment: what to fix; for a
    task another member reviews, the card says the user may decide instead). Dragging a task from «review» to
    «done» approves it, to another column opens the card for the return reason, and dropping onto «review» is
    refused (a task goes there by `task_complete`). With independent
    review on, the empty reviewer option reads
    «— (выберет доска)».
  - Subtasks (§4.2): a subtask is not a card of its own; it is in its parent's **stack**. Exception: an open subtask
    whose parent is terminal is a card, so open work never hides in «done»; it leaves its ancestors' stacks
    together with its own subtree. A subtask whose parent is missing from the snapshot is a card whatever its
    status, and tasks under a `parent_id` loop that no card reaches are the stack of a card made of the loop's
    lowest id (app.js `boardCards`, the one place of this rule). The stack holds all other descendants (depth-first
    by id, indented by level, each task once even when `parent_id` loops). A parent card shows two thin strips under
    it (the stack) while the stack is collapsed, and in its meta row a toggle button (`.stack-toggle`,
    `aria-expanded`) with one dot per direct subtask in id order (`--c-<status>`, so a free direction is grey; up to
    12, then `+N`), `done/total` in mono and a chevron; the dots and `done/total` count the direct subtasks in the
    card's stack (one shown as its own card is no dot; `done` counts the status done, failed and cancelled ones are
    in the total, in their colours), and a card with an empty stack has neither the strips nor the toggle. The
    toggle's tooltip and accessible name: «Подзадачи: готово {done} из {total}» / "Subtasks: {done} of {total}
    done". The dot of an `in_progress` subtask on the toggle pulses (a ring of transform and opacity; off under
    `prefers-reduced-motion`); the rows' dots are still. The toggle expands the stack inside the card (`.stack`): a
    row per subtask (dot, `#id`, title, the assignee's avatar, the eye icon while in review, the group chip for a
    crew task; its tooltip and accessible name «#id title · status · assignee»); a row opens that subtask's modal,
    the rest of the card opens the parent as before. A card with a stack is a `group` named «#id title», not a
    `button` (it holds the toggle and the rows, which are buttons of their own); a card without one stays a
    `button`. The board's keydown (Enter / Space) and dragstart handlers ignore events from the
    toggle and the stack: Enter on the toggle toggles, Enter on a row opens that row, and rows are not draggable (a
    subtask's status changes in its modal). Setting a terminal status on an open parent with open subtasks, by
    dropping its card on «done» or «closed», by saving its modal with the status done, failed or cancelled, or by
    approving it in review (a drop of its review card on «done» and the modal's «Принять»: the approval makes it
    done), first asks («У задачи #N открыты подзадачи: #17, #19. Закрыть всё равно?» / "Task #N has open subtasks:
    #17, #19. Close anyway?"; for a crew task «У групповой задачи #N открыты направления: …» / "Crew task #N has open
    directions: …"). The list is the open direct subtasks in id order, and between it and «Закрыть всё равно?» the
    question names what happens to them (§4.2 "Leaving and closing"), one sentence per kind that occurs: «Без
    исполнителя, отменятся вместе с ней: #17. » / "Unassigned, cancelled with it: #17. " (`todo` without an
    assignee), «Останутся открытыми, их исполнители получат уведомление: #19. » / "Stay open, their holders are
    told: #19. ", «Останутся открытыми ваши: #20. » / "Stay open, yours: #20. " (assigned to the user, who is told
    nothing) and «Останутся открытыми: #21. » / "Stay open: #21. " (open with no assignee: nobody is told). One text
    per kind of parent (an i18n key for an ordinary task and one for a crew task, with the fate sentences), the
    same for `moveTask`, `saveTask` and `reviewTask` (app.js `closeQuestion`); a parent that is already terminal is
    not asked (the cascade acts only on open -> terminal), nor is a return of a review. Cancelling the question
    leaves the task, and the modal's other unsaved edits and the review comment, unchanged. Expanded parents are
    kept in memory across renders (`S.expanded`, a set of ids), and the keyboard focus on a card, a toggle or a row
    stays on it across live re-renders of the board. A crew task's card adds a chip with the users icon
    and `2/3` (working / `crew`; its tooltip «Групповая задача: работают 2 из 3» / "Crew task: 2 of 3 working";
    the stack rows show the same chip). A subtask waiting for the user's review, at any level of a card's stack,
    puts the badge «ждёт вашего ревью» on that card (a card whose own task another member reviews keeps the chip
    naming that reviewer next to it). A filter shows a parent when it or one of its descendants
    matches, expands that stack and marks the rows that match (an accent line, `.stack-row.match`); the stack is
    open while the filter holds without changing `S.expanded`, and the toggle closes it until the search text
    changes (`S.unforced`; a stack the user had opened before the search opens again then, one the user opened
    under it and closed again stays closed). Column counts count
    cards. The task modal of a parent
    lists its subtasks as rows and, for a crew task, «Групповая задача: до N участников, сейчас работают M» / "Crew
    task: up to N members, M working now"; the create form gets «Групповая задача: участников» / "Crew task:
    members" (a number: empty or 0 = обычная задача / an ordinary task, 2–8) and «Направления» / "Directions" (a
    textarea, one per line, shown when the number is set), and the edit form the same, where the textarea adds new
    directions. The number is a text field (`inputmode="numeric"`, placeholder «2–8») with the hint «пусто или 0 —
    обычная задача; 2–8» / "empty or 0: an ordinary task; 2–8" in its label; the page checks no range: the board's
    refusal of 1 or 9 is the toast, and text that is not a whole number is sent as typed and refused (never read as
    0). Empty or 0 sends no `crew` in a create and `crew: 0` in an edit of a crew task (an ordinary task again).
    Directions are the trimmed non-blank lines, sent as a list and only while the number is on (not empty, not 0);
    hiding the textarea keeps its text (a number retyped through an empty field loses nothing), but hidden text is
    neither sent nor an unsaved edit, and a save of the edit form empties it. The directions textarea's
    hint: «по одному в строке» / "one per line" in the create form, «новые, по одному в строке» / "new ones, one per
    line" in the edit form. The modal's rows are the task's direct subtasks, all of them (also one shown as its own
    card), in id order, under «Направления» / "Directions" for a crew task and «Подзадачи» / "Subtasks" otherwise; a
    row opens that subtask (asking first about unsaved edits, as every link to a task does). The crew line and the
    rows read the board's snapshot, so they follow the subtasks live (a row with the keyboard focus keeps it).
  - Hire dialog: the role input offers the visible catalog (`GET api/roles`) and shows the matched role's
    description and model profile (matched as the hire resolves it: any of its `names`, hidden roles included),
    or that a typed name is a new role to describe in the instructions; the
    model select starts with «— профиль роли или сессии» (`model` is sent only when chosen); instructions are
    optional for a catalog role (sent as "").
  - Goal modal: the goal is a textarea with the split hint (first line = title), sent unchanged (the hub splits).
    In a thread session it warns that #1 and #2 are rewritten and the goal votes cleared, an active goal has «Цель
    достигнута» (`swarm_control` `complete_goal`, §22.4), and `#goal-btn` opens #1 instead of it once #1 exists (the
    goal modal before that, and from #1's «Изменить цель»; §22.8).
  - Settings dialog (⚙ «Настройки роя»): budget and max agents (`swarm_control`, stored in the session's
    database; sent only when changed). On a launcher session other than `main` it loads `GET /api/sessions/{sid}`
    and `GET /api/settings` (launcher routes, without `BASE`) and adds the groups «Фоновые процессы»
    (`shell.max_jobs_per_member`, `max_jobs`, `job_max_minutes`, `cpu_threads`) and «Агенты»
    (`agents.max_steps_per_turn`, `context_tokens`, `tool_output_chars`, `idle_nudge_seconds`,
    `max_parallel_llm_calls`, `planning_hint_steps`, `planning_hint_minutes`, `file_settle_seconds`,
    `file_max_wait_seconds`, `trigger_wake_seconds`: «Повторяющийся триггер будит не чаще, с» with the hint
    «Срабатывания между пробуждениями приходят одним уведомлением; 0 — будить при каждом») and «Сеть»
    (`swarm.network`, kind `choice`: a select «как в общих настройках (…)» / «есть» / «нет», with the hint
    `networkHint` of the launcher's `network_isolation`, §7.2) and «Уточнение цели» (`swarm.clarify`, field
    «Сначала уточнять цель», kind `bool`: a
    select «как в общих настройках (вкл|выкл)» / «вкл» / «выкл», parsed to null / true / false; its hint says that an
    agent's critical question then pauses the swarm until the user answers, that a new planning task starts with
    questions, and that a planning task already on the board stays as it is, §3.1) (`SESSION_FIELDS`, where a field's
    `hint` key names its hint text). Each input holds the session's own override (empty when none) and
    shows the global value (the public view of `/api/settings`, defaults filled) as its placeholder; a hint says
    that an empty field takes the general value and that changes apply at once (steps from the agent's next
    wake-up, the rest from the next command or call), the context field that a model profile's own window wins
    (naming it when the session's profile has one). Save checks the values with config.py's minimums (whole
    numbers; `idle_nudge_seconds`, `planning_hint_minutes` and the three trigger keys numbers; `cpu_threads` "auto"
    or a whole number ≥ 0; the first error is a toast and gets the focus), then sends `PATCH /api/sessions/{sid}`
    `{"settings": ...}` with only the changed keys (an emptied field is null) before `swarm_control`, so a stopped
    session takes them too; when the PATCH succeeds and
    `swarm_control` fails, a toast says the session parameters were saved and the dialog stays open with them counted
    as saved. An emptied field counts as an unsaved edit when the dialog is closed (it removes an override). ⚙ is
    disabled while the two requests load, and a modal opened meanwhile is not replaced; if they fail, the dialog
    keeps budget and max agents with a line that the session parameters did not load. The pure parts are
    exported for the Node tests (`parseSessionField`, `sessionSettingsPatch`, `sessionFieldsHtml`, `contextHint`).
    Every session's dialog starts with the read-only line of its work mode; in a thread session the planning-hint fields
    carry the clarify asker's hint and the group «Тред» has `swarm.goal_rule` and `agents.digest_seconds`
    (`SESSION_FIELDS` `modes`, `sessionFields(mode)`, §22.8).
    `main` and a standalone `dreamteam run` board show only budget and max agents, with a line that the other
    parameters are in the general settings.
  - Header: the badge «Без интернета» (`#net-badge`) while the snapshot's `swarm.network.mode` is "off", its
    tooltip `networkHint(swarm.network.isolation)` (§7.2); the sessions page's card shows the same badge for a
    summary with `network: "off"`.
  - Background jobs (§7.1; «фоновый процесс» in Russian, shown as j3): the tab «Процессы» (badge: the running
    ones) has a card per job of the snapshot's `jobs` (running, then ended in the last hour): label, owner chip,
    state («работает 25 мин»; at the end by status and reason: «завершён: код 0», «завершён» for a job with no
    code of its own, «остановлен вами», «остановлен по пределу времени»…), for a silent one (`silent_since`, §7.1)
    a warn badge with the clock icon «40 мин без вывода» (tooltip: it may hang, look at its output and stop it if it
    is stuck), origin, process names while it runs,
    how long it ran and when it ended, and its log (a workspace log is a link that opens it in «Файлы»).
    «Вывод» shows its last 200 lines (`POST api/act/jobs {job_id, tail: 200}`), refreshed every 3 s while the
    tab is open and the job runs; «Остановить» asks first («Остановить процесс j3 и всё, что он запустил?»),
    then `POST api/act/job_stop {job_id}`. Keyboard focus stays on a card's button when the cards are rebuilt.
    In the team panel a member with running jobs has the marker ⚙N (tooltip «фоновых процессов: N»), and its
    drawer lists them, each with «Остановить». The feed shows `job.started` / `job.ended` (FEED_TYPES `job.*`).
    The header's agents counter is `swarm.agent_count` (members who joined through MCP do not count) against
    max_agents.
  - Tab «Триггеры»: a card per active trigger of the snapshot (condition, a repeat badge, owner, «срабатываний: N»
    and, while its fires are held by the wake limit, «отложено: 2 до 18:48» / "held: 2 until 18:48" from `held` and
    `wake_at`, §8; note, actions, last error; «Удалить» asks first).
  - Tab «Файлы»: above the tree, the session folder (`swarm.workspace`): its absolute path (click to copy) and
    the badge «своя папка» / «папка проекта» / «перенесена» / «папки нет», then «Сменить папку…» ("Folders on both
    pages": hidden on a standalone `dreamteam run` board, for `main` and for a session of an earlier version); the
    tab button's tooltip is the path. A missing folder is not listed (no `/api/files` call). When the path (or its
    existence) changes after a move (this dialog, `/cd` or another client), the tab starts again from the root of
    the new folder. A locked entry (its path is the path of a
    lock in the snapshot's `locks`) shows the lock icon («Заблокирован: {owner}» as its tooltip) and the link «Снять
    блокировку» / "Unlock" (`.file-unlock`): after a `confirm()` («Снять блокировку, которую поставил(а) {owner}, с
    {path}? Участников, которые ждут этот файл, разбудят.») it calls `act('file_unlock', {path})` (§7 "Lock
    waiters"); cancelling sends nothing. The viewer highlights the syntax of a file
    (and the source of a `.md`) by its name (`highlight.js`, in-house, offline, loaded before markdown.js; also
    Markdown fences that name a language): Python, JS/TS, JSON, TOML, YAML, INI/.env, shell, Dockerfile, Makefile,
    PowerShell, batch, HTML/XML/SVG, CSS, SCSS/LESS, SQL, C/C++, C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Lua, R, Julia, LaTeX,
    Markdown, diff; other kinds (CSV, text) and files over 300 000 characters stay plain. Safe and copy-exact:
    everything is escaped, the only markup is `<span class="hl-…">`, the text content is the file; one linear pass.
  - Tab «Трейсы»: agent filter, status filter (all statuses, «Только с ошибками» = failed), refresh and
    «Статистика»; the list of traces on the left (newest first, «Показать ещё» pages with `before`) and the
    trace detail on the right.
    - Trace detail: header (status, duration, steps, LLM calls, tools, errors, tokens, cost, tasks, what woke

    - Clicking a span expands it: thinking, text, tool calls, arguments and the result (marked when the
      model saw a shortened result, with «Загрузить полностью»); «Контекст запроса» opens
      `/api/spans/{id}/context` in a wide modal.
    - Buttons «Экспорт JSON», «JSON с контекстами» and JSONL of the agent.
    - Live updates come from the `trace.*` WS events (a running trace reloads; opened details stay open).
  - Agent drawer: the button «Трейсы» opens the tab filtered to that agent.
  - Skills tab (§19; the tab after «MCP», a warning badge with the number of proposals waiting): a bar with

    (`deps`): «готовы» with the environment's path (click to copy), «ставятся…» (in the queue / another DreamTeam
    process builds it), «ошибка» with the error, «Журнал» (`GET api/skills/{name}/deps-log`) and «Переустановить»
    (`skill_reinstall`), or «вручную» with the reason (off, proposals off, missing on this machine, another Python,
    unsupported). Buttons: «Показать» (files and SKILL.md, `?from=session`), «Сохранить в библиотеку» / «Не
    сохранять» for a pending proposal (`skill_approve`; the clash text asks before `replace`), «Обновить» only when
    the skill's own source changed (its `source_digest` in `GET api/skills` differs from the copy's digest; never
    for a member's proposal: `<from>:name` with `replace`), «Отключить» (asks first). «Подключить скилл» opens a
    dialog listing the library's, the host's and Claude Code's skills not attached yet (a warning for one agents can
    write or one changed outside DreamTeam asks before attaching), each with «Показать» and «Подключить»
    (`skill_attach`), plus the shared form with «Добавить и подключить» (`attach: true`). On a standalone board
    (`dreamteam run`, no launcher home page) the tab also has the library itself under «Библиотека скиллов» (show,
    delete). The feed shows `skill.*` (attached, updated, detached, proposed, saved or not, packages ready or failed);
    a member's row and drawer and the hire dialog's role preview show the role's skills.

## 19. Skills (skills.py)

A **skill** is an Anthropic Agent Skill: a folder whose root holds `SKILL.md` (YAML front matter with `name` and
`description`, then instructions) plus any other files (`scripts/`, references, templates). Agents see names and
descriptions and read a SKILL.md when a task matches it (progressive disclosure). In Russian texts: «скилл».
Nothing from a skill is ever run, imported or rendered as HTML by DreamTeam: it is data until an agent reads it.

**Concepts.** The *library* (`[skills] library_dir`, default `~/.dreamteam/skills`, §17.1) is shared by every
session of every home on the machine. A library entry's *origin* says where it came from: `folder`, `zip`, `git`,
`agent` (a proposal the user saved), `claude-user`, `claude-project` (copied from Claude Code) or `host-library`
(copied in the Docker sandbox from the host's library). *Claude Code skills* (candidates) are found read-only in
`$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills` (default `~/.claude/skills`; origin `claude-user`) and in `<workspace>/.claude/skills`
(origin `claude-project`, agent-writable). Claude Code plugin skills (`~/.claude/plugins`) are not offered (v1).

**Names** (`NAME_RE = [a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*`, `NAME_MAX = 64`; "anthropic" and "claude" are allowed):
`check_name(name)` (SkillError 400) is called by every function that takes a name before any path is built (reads,
writes, removals), and `child(root, name)` asserts the joined path resolves to a direct child of `root`: `..`, `.`,
`a/b`, `..\x`, a decoded `%5C` and a planted link never reach a file operation. `slug(text)` makes a name of any
text (Cyrillic transliterated, accents dropped: "My Skill" → `my-skill`). `for_agents(text)` replaces `<` / `>`
with ‹ › in every text built for agents.

**References** (`parse_ref(text) -> (source | None, name)`, `looks_like_ref(text)`): `x`, `library:x`,
`claude-user:x`, `claude-project:x`, and `host-library:x` in the sandbox. A Git scp URL (it has an `@`) and a
Windows path (a one-letter drive) are not references. `resolve_ref(config, ref, *, workspace=None) -> {"origin",
"name", "path"}`: a prefixed reference uses only that source; a bare name the library, then `claude-user` (when
`[skills] claude`), then `host-library` (sandbox only). `claude-project` is used **only** when named, because agents
can write `<workspace>/.claude/skills` (and a cloned repository may bring one). Nothing found: SkillError 404 "No
skill 'x' in the library or in ~/.claude/skills. Library: a, b." plus, when the workspace has one, "attach
claude-project:x to use it".

**Validation** (`check_skill_dir(folder, limits, *, strict=False, digest=True) -> SkillInfo(name, description,
path, files, size, digest, manual, manifest, renamed_from, skipped)`; `Limits(max_mb, max_files, max_archive_mb)`,
`Limits.from_config(config)`):
- `SKILL.md` at the root, spelled exactly (`skill.md` only on a case-insensitive file system, stored as `SKILL.md`),
  a regular file (not a link), at most `SKILL_MD_MAX` = 100 000 bytes, UTF-8 (a BOM is stripped). The skill folder
  itself must not be a link.
- `parse_frontmatter(text) -> dict[str, str]` (stdlib, no PyYAML): the first non-blank line is `---`, the front
  matter closes with `---` or `...` within 200 lines; top-level `key: value` with plain values (a ` #comment`
  stripped, indented continuation lines folded), `'single'` (`''` escape) and `"double"` (`\" \\ \n \t`) quotes, and
  block scalars `|` / `>` (with `-` / `+`); nested maps and lists are skipped, unknown keys ignored except
  `disable-model-invocation: true` → `manual` ("only when the user asks for it").
- `name`: the front matter's, else the folder's name (`fallback`: for a zip's or a clone's root, which is a
  staging folder, the zip's file name without `.zip`, or the Git subdir's last part, else the repository's name
  without `.git`). `strict=True` (agent proposals): it must match the rule as written; otherwise (imports, Claude Code) it is slugged and the report says `renamed_from`. The copy is stored under
  this name, not the folder's.
- `description`: required; whitespace collapsed; 1–1024 characters. `<` / `>` are kept (replaced only in agent
  texts); `strict=True` refuses tag-like text (`<tag`).
- The tree: `.git`, `node_modules`, caches (`workspace.NO_EXPAND`), `.DS_Store`, `__MACOSX`, `Thumbs.db` and our
  `.dreamteam.json` are skipped silently; links and junctions (`workspace.is_link`) and special files are skipped
  and reported in `skipped: [{path, error}]`, never followed; every path part must be portable (the Windows rules on
  every OS: no `<>:"|?*\`, control characters, trailing dot or space, reserved device names); two paths equal after
  NFC + casefold fail the skill naming both; at most `max_files` files, `max_mb` MB and 8 folder levels (413).
  Binary files are allowed.
- `digest`: sha256 over the sorted `"<posix rel>\0<sha256 of the bytes>"` lines (without `.dreamteam.json`): "same
  content". `manifest`: `[[rel, size, mtime_ns]]` of the walk, cheap to recompute (`stat_manifest`): "changed since".

**Safe copy** (`copy_skill(src, dest_parent, name, limits, *, strict=False, info=None, readonly=False, meta=None)
-> SkillInfo` of the copy): validated first (`info`: a check already made); built file by file in
`dest_parent/.t-<hex6>-<epoch>/` (same volume, a short name); each file is opened only after `lstat` says it is a regular
file, and the opened file must be that same file (`fstat` inode), so a link swapped in after the check is never
followed; the digest of the bytes written must equal the checked one ("the folder changed while it was being copied;
try again", 409). Source mode bits `& 0o755` are kept (scripts stay executable, the owner can write); `readonly`
makes the files 0o444 / 0o555 (the agents' mirror); `meta` writes `.dreamteam.json` into the copy before it appears.
The swap: an existing `<name>` (or a link there, never followed) is renamed to `.o-<hex6>-<epoch>`, the new folder
renamed in, the old one removed; a failure restores the old one. Renames are retried 5 times over about a second on `PermissionError` (a scanner or an indexer
holding a file). Every file operation uses `workspace.long_path`. `clean_stale(parent)` removes `.t-*` / `.o-*`
folders older than an hour (`Library.list` and staging call it), judged by the later of the time in the name and the
mtime (a rename keeps an old mtime: an `.o-` copy mid-swap must not look stale).

**The library** (`Library(root, limits=None, *, read_only=False, config=None)`, `Library.from_config(config)`,
`Library.host(config)`): one folder per skill; `.dreamteam.json` = `{name, description, origin, source, added_at,
updated_at, digest, manifest, by, via, files, size, manual}`, where `source` is `{path}` (folder, Claude Code, host
library), `{filename, subdir?}` (zip) or `{url, ref, subdir, commit}` (Git; the redacted URL), `by` is `user` or a
member, and `via` the surface (`act`, `mcp`, `launcher-mcp`, `stopped-session`, `home`, `cli`).
- `list()` (sorted; folders whose name is not a skill name and dot folders are left out), `get(name)`,
  `path(name)` (a valid entry's folder), `show(name)` (entry + `show_folder`: `files_list` [{path, size}] ≤ 500,
  `skill_md` and `deps`; a link entry `deps: {}`),
  `digest_of(name)` (hashed again when the entry changed outside), `add(folder, origin, source, *, replace=False,
  by="user", via="act", strict=False, info=None)`, `remove(name)` (renamed away, then removed; 404 when missing; a
  link removes only the link).
- A public entry: `{name, description, origin, source, added_at, updated_at, files, size, digest, manual, by, via,
  changed_outside}`; a folder that fails validation is `{name, error, origin}` (shown, not attachable), and so is a
  link or junction there (never followed: one link cannot break the listing). Missing metadata (a folder dropped in,
  or its `.dreamteam.json` deleted) is rebuilt from SKILL.md once: origin `folder`, `by` "", `via` `outside` and
  `outside: true`, which keeps `changed_outside` true.
- **Tamper signal**: `changed_outside` is true when the stat walk differs from the stored manifest (a file edited,
  added or removed behind DreamTeam's back) or the entry was not added through DreamTeam; it stays until the skill
  is imported again (which records the new `by` / `via`) or deleted. A signal, not a protection.
- `add`: the same name with the same digest is `"unchanged": true` (only `updated_at` and `source` change, and a
  stale manifest is rewritten); other content is SkillError 409 `exists: [name]` unless `replace` (then `added_at`
  is kept). No lock between processes: every change is a rename.
- `read_only` (the host library in the sandbox): `add` / `remove` raise 403 "The host's skills library is read-only
  inside the sandbox."
- `sessions._plan` refuses a workspace that is the skills library, inside it or containing it (§17.2).

**Sources.** `stage_source(lib, spec, *, pick=None, workspace=None) -> Staged` fetches and validates into
`library_dir/.t-<hex6>/` (nothing visible in the library); `Staged.commit(replace=False, by="user", via="act")`
checks every clash first (409 `exists` listing all of them, nothing added) and adds the picked skills with
`Library.add`; `Staged.discard()` (also on leaving `with`) removes the staging folder; `Staged.conflicts()` names
the picked skills the library has with other content; `import_source(lib, spec, *, pick, replace, workspace, by,
via)` is stage + commit. `spec`: `{"path": abs}` (a folder on the hub's machine, or a `.zip` file read from disk;
relative: 400), `{"zip": base64, "filename"}`, `{"git": url}`, `{"claude": name, "origin": "claude-user" |
"claude-project"}`, `{"host": name}` (sandbox). The report: `{"imported": [entry + "unchanged"], "candidates":
[{name, description, path, files, size, digest, manual, renamed_from?, error?, deps}], "skipped": [{path, error}],
"need_pick": bool}`.
- `find_skills(root, limits, max_depth=4)`: the root alone when it has a SKILL.md, else every folder with one down to
  4 levels (no links, the skip-list left out, never below a found skill); each candidate is checked; a second one
  with the same name gets "duplicate name". No valid candidate: the single candidate's own error, or 400 "No SKILL.md
  found in …"; exactly one valid or `pick` given: those (an unknown name is 400, a picked candidate's error is
  raised); several without `pick`: `need_pick`, nothing imported.
- Folder and Claude Code sources are copied into the staging folder first, so the commit takes what was checked.
- Zip (`extract_zip(data, dest, limits) -> skipped`): the base64 text is capped before decoding
  (`Limits.zip_b64_max`, 413); members: `\` read as `/`; absolute names, drive letters, `..`, `.` and empty parts,
  duplicates, NFC + casefold collisions (also a file beside a folder of that name), link entries and encrypted
  entries are refused; directories are implied; `__MACOSX/`, `.DS_Store` and `.dreamteam.json` skipped; the
  portable-name rule applies; at most 5000 entries; the declared sizes and the bytes actually streamed are both
  capped by `max_archive_mb` (413); a member over 1 MB compressed more than 200 times "looks like a zip bomb" (413);
  a damaged archive is a 400; exec bits come from `external_attr`. `max_mb` / `max_files` apply per picked skill,
  so a multi-skill "Download ZIP" of a repository fits. Origin `zip`, `source = {filename, subdir?}`.
  `extract_zip` is a wrapper: `unpack_zip(source, dest, ZipRules.for_skills(limits)).skipped`. `unpack_zip(source:
  bytes | path | binary file (the caller's, left open), dest, rules: ZipRules, *, check=None) -> ZipResult(files,
  bytes, skipped, excluded, links, top)` is
  the one unpacker, also for a zip copied into a new session (`copyfrom.zip_rules`, §17.2 "Copying files into a new
  session"). `ZipRules`: `max_bytes` / `too_big`, `max_entries` / `too_many_entries`, `max_files` /
